brief:
Gaza's security crisis has escalated beyond aerial bombardment to encompassing broader lawlessness and societal breakdown, Shehab Wire reported. Residents now face threats not only from military strikes but also from disorder and institutional failure, which the occupation deliberately seeks to institutionalize, according to the report.

The deteriorating conditions reflect a shift in the nature of threats facing Palestinians in the enclave, where survival increasingly depends on navigating both armed conflict and the collapse of civil order and governance structures.

title: Occupation aims to entrench chaos and collapse in Gaza
